name: Kikai na Kanojo
source:
I've got a girlfriend. She's smart, sporty, always on top of her chores and exactly my type.
She's perfect, save for one thing.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21631]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我有女朋友了。她聪明，擅长运动，家务也总能打理得井井有条，完全是我喜欢的类型。
她十分完美，唯独有一点例外。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21631]Freem![/url]]
